question: For male legislators from Louisiana, how many distinct legislators were actively serving on December 31 of each year from more than 30 years since their first term up to less than 50 years, grouping the results by the exact number of years elapsed since their first term?
sql:
-- Final query with proper year calculation
WITH male_la_legislators AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT l.id_bioguide
    FROM legislators l
    JOIN legislators_terms lt ON l.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
    WHERE l.gender = 'M' AND lt.state = 'LA'
),
first_terms AS (
    SELECT lt.id_bioguide, MIN(CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE)) as first_term_start
    FROM legislators_terms lt
    JOIN male_la_legislators ml ON lt.id_bioguide = ml.id_bioguide
    WHERE lt.state = 'LA'
    GROUP BY lt.id_bioguide
),
dec31_dates AS (
    SELECT DATE(yr || '-12-31') AS dec31_date
    FROM unnest(generate_series(1824, 2024)) AS t(yr)
),
serving_dates AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT lt.id_bioguide, ds.dec31_date, ft.first_term_start
    FROM legislators_terms lt
    JOIN male_la_legislators ml ON lt.id_bioguide = ml.id_bioguide
    JOIN first_terms ft ON lt.id_bioguide = ft.id_bioguide
    JOIN dec31_dates ds 
        ON ds.dec31_date >= CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE)
        AND ds.dec31_date <= CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE)
),
with_years AS (
    SELECT id_bioguide, dec31_date, first_term_start,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(dec31_date, first_term_start))::INTEGER as years_elapsed
    FROM serving_dates
)
SELECT years_elapsed, COUNT(DISTINCT id_bioguide) as distinct_legislators
FROM with_years
WHERE years_elapsed > 30 AND years_elapsed < 50
GROUP BY years_elapsed
ORDER BY years_elapsed
